tokens.name: idea-pink
tokens.usage: The IDEA Pink, the masterbrand colour. Primary buttons, the Pink Band, avatars, app icon, the Pink Mailer, active states. Text on it: on-pink (white, 4.95:1). Bulb Yellow on it for the bulb and large text (3.2:1, 24px+).

tokens.name: idea-pink-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of idea-pink fills; on-pink text 6.6:1.

tokens.name: on-pink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on idea-pink and idea-pink-hover.

tokens.name: pink-text
tokens.usage: Pink used as text or lines: links, the wordmark on paper, prices (4.7:1 on paper, 6.2:1 on ink).

tokens.name: bulb-yellow
tokens.usage: The bulb and the second brand colour: the bulb on pink, Highlights, yellow buttons on pink panels, the internal Staff tile, the Bulbs icon. Never as text on paper (1.4:1).

tokens.name: bulb-yellow-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of bulb-yellow fills.

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text on bulb-yellow (12.5:1). Logos on yellow use idea-pink instead (3.2:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on every surface (17:1). Text only: never in logos, tiles or brand blocks.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface and surface-sunken (5.6:1+ light, 6.8:1+ dark).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: warm paper in light, deep ink in dark mode.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, popovers.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, wells, product image grounds.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control edges (3:1+ on every surface).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element (ink on paper and on pink 3.8:1+, yellow on dark 11:1+).

tokens.name: plus
tokens.usage: The IDEA Plus accent: plan marks (Plus Glow, Shine, Blaze), plan flags, the rent button. Text on it: on-accent.

tokens.name: business
tokens.usage: The IDEA Business accent and the info colour. Text on it: on-accent.

tokens.name: club
tokens.usage: The IDEA Club accent: event tags, Club bands. Fill only; text on it is on-accent-warm.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on plus and business fills (5.2:1+).

tokens.name: on-accent-warm
tokens.usage: Text on club fills (6.6:1+).

tokens.name: meter-empty
tokens.usage: The empty steps of a condition meter. Decorative: the condition word always sits beside it.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Delivered, paid, in stock. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Low stock, delayed, waitlist. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: a true red, apart from the magenta brand pink in hue. Always with an alert icon and a word, because both sit at a similar lightness.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Text on success and danger fills.
